situation (example wording): "share of murders where victim was black, 2015 - 2025, in Washington, D.C.", "What percentage of murder victims in Houston were black from 2020 to 2022?"
what the app does today: Declined ("this breakdown (by two things at once, several crimes broken down, or a combined total by period), or this rate or share").
proposed behavior: The share of murder (or homicide) victims of one race is a table from Homicide Reports, a row for each year of the period: the year, all the murder victims, the victims of that race, and that race's share of all that year's victims. The share is shown as in P162, a column headed "Share (%)" to one decimal. Title: the place, "Share of Murder Victims Who Were <Race>", the period written "2015 to 2025". A single year is the same table with one row.
exact default or choices offered: Columns: Year | Murder victims | Black victims | Share (%). Title: "Washington, D.C. Share of Murder Victims Who Were Black, 2015 to 2025".
